title: ATR community ledger event
description: One line of community/ledger.jsonl. An event is a public, verifiable piece of work. Tiers are computed from events by scripts/community/ledger.ts; nothing else grants a tier. There is deliberately no event type for payments, sponsorship or membership fees: money never grants a tier.

id.description: Unique within the ledger, for example E1-agent-threat-rules-pr-812.

code.description: E1 accepted contribution; E2 review comment that led to a change; E3 confirmed defect in a rule, test or mapping; E4 receipt signed by someone other than the maintainers and verified by CI; E5 calibration run under a plan fixed before the runs; E6 mapping reviewed by someone from the framework concerned; E7 adoption by an organization, re-checked monthly; E8 a contribution adopted by another unit or cited by a receipt; E9 test question (atomic) accepted out of draft.

actor.description: Who did the work: gh:<github login, lowercase>, orcid:<id>, or org:<slug> for E7.

evidence.description: Public link that proves the event: a merged pull request, an issue comment, a verified receipt.

verified_by.description: ci when a deterministic check decided it; otherwise the maintainer who confirmed it. Nobody verifies their own event.

area.description: Working group the event belongs to. Drives the 'working on' line on member cards.

subject.description: What the event is about: a PR, rule id, atomic id or profile id.
